content.intro: Start with one department, or commit to three connected department workspaces. Both options begin with your people and the way work moves across campus. The three-workspace bundle adds a better combined price as those departments come online.

value.heading: A clear bundle advantage
value.basis: Compared with three separate one-workspace packages: $9,000 setup and $3,000 per month. The bundle is $7,000 setup and $2,500 per month when all three workspaces are active. These differences exclude usage and additional approved work; actual billing follows staged activation.

content.activation_note: Departments launch sequentially. Monthly fees begin at each workspace's approved activation, subject to the existing Implementation Timeline, Client Dependencies, and Billing Commencement provision. Calendar dates and setup invoice due dates remain to be agreed.
content.scope_note: Both options cover the selected campus-operations workflows. Admissions and large-scale marketing are outside the initial offer. Additional departments, substantial workflows, major integrations, large migrations and software replacement require a separate scope and written price approval.
content.next_step: Choose the first department and its launch checklist, confirm the selected package, then agree scope, responsibilities, activation milestones and usage controls.
